topics.name: Overall Satisfaction
topics.description: Reviewer expresses general approval or disapproval of the product without citing a specific aspect.

topics.name: Product Effectiveness
topics.description: How well the product performs its intended function or delivers the promised results.

topics.name: Value and Gifting
topics.description: Whether the product is worth the price and suitable as a gift.

topics.name: Ease of Application and Instructions
topics.description: How easy or difficult the product is to put on, install, apply, or use, including the clarity, language, and usefulness of included instructions.

topics.name: Durability and Build Quality
topics.description: Whether the product is well made, holds up over time, or breaks, falls apart, or sheds with use.

topics.name: Hair Quality
topics.description: Softness, thickness, tangling, volume, and styling or dyeing behavior of hair products and extensions.

topics.name: Fit and Size
topics.description: Whether the product is the right size, stretches enough, or fits comfortably on the head or body.

topics.name: Style and Aesthetic Appeal
topics.description: How cute, attractive, or stylish the product's design looks, apart from color accuracy.

topics.name: Shipping, Order Accuracy and Customer Service
topics.description: Speed of delivery, whether the correct, complete, and undamaged items arrived, and how the seller handles replacements, refunds, and returns.

topics.name: Scent
topics.description: How the product smells, including whether the fragrance is pleasant, strong, or changes over time.

topics.name: Color and Appearance Accuracy
topics.description: Whether colors, brightness, and look match the photo or description, including receiving wrong colors.

topics.name: Texture and Consistency
topics.description: Feel of the product itself, such as thick, gooey, smooth, thin, or sudsy.

topics.name: Accuracy of Claims
topics.description: Whether marketing claims and the product description are truthful and match what is delivered.

topics.name: Comfort During Use
topics.description: How comfortable or uncomfortable the product feels while being worn or used.

topics.name: Longevity and Wear Time
topics.description: How long the product's effect, color, or hold lasts after application.

topics.name: Portability and Storage
topics.description: Whether the product is compact, travel-friendly, roomy enough, or helps organize and store items.

topics.name: Product Quantity and Fill
topics.description: Whether the amount of product in the container or package is sufficient and how quickly it runs out.

topics.name: Packaging and Container Quality
topics.description: Quality of the bottle, lid, seal, dispenser, or outer packaging and whether it leaks, is defective, or is cheap.

topics.name: Compatibility with Other Products
topics.description: Whether the product works well or poorly when layered, mixed, or used alongside other products.

topics.name: Skin Irritation or Harm
topics.description: Whether the product causes redness, irritation, or physical damage to skin.

topics.name: Power Source and Features
topics.description: Whether power type, included parts, and built-in features meet the reviewer's needs.

topics.name: Residue and Mess
topics.description: Whether the product leaves behind sticky, waxy, or staining residue on skin, clothing, or the device.

topics.name: Ease of Removal
topics.description: How easy or difficult it is to take off, wash out, or extract the product from skin, lashes, or hair.

topics.name: Safety and Trustworthiness
topics.description: Whether the product is recommended by professionals, safe to use, and trusted by the reviewer.

topics.name: Ingredients and Eco-Friendliness
topics.description: Whether the ingredients, formulation, or environmental friendliness of the product meet the reviewer's expectations.

topics.name: Product Freshness and Condition
topics.description: Whether the product arrived fresh and usable rather than dried out, stale, old, or faded.

topics.name: Climate and Wearing Conditions
topics.description: How the product performs in heat or other conditions, including side effects like fogging glasses.

topics.name: Flavor and Taste
topics.description: How strong, weak, or pleasant the taste or flavor of an ingestible or oral-contact product is.

topics.name: Billing and Subscription Practices
topics.description: Whether the seller charges the advertised price and discloses recurring charges or automatic subscriptions.
